wx-alert-phone.action: View opens Melaton Weather on the alert (soft key); Dismiss clears it and the inbox copy
wx-alert-phone.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Weather: Alert / Weather: Severe alert (wmSounds per event: Play sound, Display message, Vibrate, Repeat)
wx-alert-phone.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alert for a place she configured (Home, Work, here). N6: the server's inbox copy wx:<alertId> has the same id and is only marked seen when this page shows its note (wmNotificationInbox.shownBy); the page's title carries the severity and the inbox's does not, so the title match could not dedupe it

wx-alert-balloon.area: Desktop weather alert tray balloon (weatherAlerts.js onIssued, PopoverManager popup id weather-alert)
wx-alert-balloon.action: a click opens Melaton Weather on the alert
wx-alert-balloon.switch: tray icon notification settings (trayRegistry popup 'weather-alert', trayPopupHidden) and the Weather Alert tray icon behaviour
wx-alert-balloon.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alert for a place she configured; one balloon per alert (shown set), one popup id so a second replaces the first (N9); no sound of its own

wx-rain-alarm.action: Weather soft key opens Melaton Weather; Dismiss clears it
wx-rain-alarm.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Weather: Rain alarm (wmSounds), and Melaton Weather settings for the alarm itself
wx-rain-alarm.note: N1/N4/N5 ok: an alarm she configured, once per rain spell; N6: same id rain:<place> as the server's copy, marked seen through wmNotificationInbox.shownBy

wm-chat-arrival.area: Melaton Mobile Dreamscape Messenger note (wmChat.js arrived / showSmsNote)
wm-chat-arrival.action: tap opens the conversation (or the list); Reply opens Quick Reply
wm-chat-arrival.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Dreamscape Messenger: New message (wmSounds chat: Play sound, Display message, Vibrate)
wm-chat-arrival.note: content she asked for (a persona's reply). N3: only when that chat is not on screen (viewing check in onStreamComplete / onMessageResponse). N6/N9: a reply landing within BURST_MS of the last sound while that note is up changes it in place, silently

wm-sms-arrival.area: Melaton Mobile text message note (wmChat.js tmOnMessage / tmShowNote)
wm-sms-arrival.action: tap opens the conversation; Reply opens Quick Reply
wm-sms-arrival.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Text Messaging: New text message (wmSounds sms)
wm-sms-arrival.note: delivery of the text itself. N3: not when that conversation is on screen. N6/N9: a text within BURST_MS of the last sound while the note is up changes it in place, silently; the app's native text notice posts instead when the page is behind

wm-chat-reply-open.area: Melaton Mobile open Dreamscape Messenger conversation (wmChat.js onStreamComplete / onMessageResponse)
wm-chat-reply-open.action: content: the reply is the line that just landed in the open conversation; no notice is raised
wm-chat-reply-open.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Dreamscape Messenger: New message (Play sound)
wm-chat-reply-open.note: N7 ok: the reply to her message arriving (the device's in-conversation message sound); sound only, no bubble

wm-chat-failure.area: Melaton Mobile Messenger / Text Messaging failures (wmChat.js failBox, stalled reply, message not sent)
wm-chat-failure.action: content: the failure text itself (a message box when it answers her tap)
wm-chat-failure.switch: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Errors / Warnings (wmSounds)
wm-chat-failure.note: N10 ok: an error that stopped her message, told once in words; no second toast

wm-chat-quick-reply.area: Melaton Mobile Quick Reply dialog (wmChat.js quickReply)
wm-chat-quick-reply.action: she pressed Reply on a text / chat note: Send, View, Cancel
wm-chat-quick-reply.switch: none: asked for by her Reply key
wm-chat-quick-reply.note: not unsolicited: the dialog is the answer to her tap

wm-chat-confirm.area: Melaton Mobile Messenger destructive confirmations (wmChat.js delete / restart conversation, delete message)
wm-chat-confirm.action: Yes / No answer her own delete or restart tap
wm-chat-confirm.switch: none: asked for by her tap
wm-chat-confirm.note: a confirmation of a destructive action she just chose, not a notice

wm-settings-error.action: content: the failure of the Settings change she just made, in the Settings window
wm-settings-error.switch: none: failure of her own save
wm-settings-error.note: N10 ok: told once where it failed
